chunks: That Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام saw a man who had a nosebleed while he was in salat (prayer), and he inserted his hand into his nose and brought out blood. So he gestured to him with his hand: "Rub it with your hand and pray."

key_terms.أَنْفِهِ: His nose, from which the blood emerged
key_terms.اُفْرُكْهُ: Wipe it or rub it off

ai.seo_question: What should someone do if a nosebleed occurs during salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith describes Imām Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام instructing a man who experienced a nosebleed during salat (prayer) to wipe away the blood with his hand and continue praying. It is used in jurisprudential discussion concerning minor bleeding and what does or does not interrupt salat (prayer).

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1054 - Bukayr ibn Ayyan narrated that Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) saw a man who had a nosebleed during prayer. The man put his hand into his nose, took out blood, and the Imam gestured to him with his hand, saying,
"Wipe it with your hand and continue praying."
